title: AWS SSM Parameter Store Secret Extraction

theory.intro: AWS SSM Parameter Store Secret Extraction is a core security discipline in AWS cloud operations.

sections.heading: Understanding AWS SSM Parameter Store Secret Extraction
sections.content: In modern cloud environments, proper configuration of AWS SSM Parameter Store Secret Extraction ensures privilege boundaries and access controls prevent unauthorized resource manipulation.

sections.heading: Security Risks & Attack Vectors
sections.content: Misconfigurations related to AWS SSM Parameter Store Secret Extraction allow attackers to perform unauthorized reconnaissance, privilege escalation, and persistent access within your cloud tenant.

sections.heading: Defense & Mitigation Strategies
sections.content: Enforce strict principle of least privilege, continuous auditing via CloudTrail/Config, and automated guardrails.
